# MaintenEase

> Modern maintenance management software (CMMS) for teams that maintain assets, buildings, and fleets. Account plans include seats and published capacity limits. Work orders, preventive maintenance, inspections, assets, and a public request portal live in one place.

Starter is $49/month with 2 included seats; Pro is $129/month with 4 included seats; Business is $299/month with 4 included seats. Additional Business seats are $15/month. Starter supports up to 50 assets and 100 work orders per month. Pro supports up to 500 assets and 2,000 work orders per month. Business includes unlimited assets and unlimited work orders. 7-day free trial. Month-to-month billing. Free data import and onboarding.

Every canonical public page below has an explicit Markdown URL. Do not guess or construct a URL: use the complete directory in this file or https://maintenease.com/api/ai.json. Clients may also request a canonical HTML URL with `Accept: text/markdown`; negotiated responses send `Vary: Accept`, `Content-Location`, and canonical/alternate `Link` headers. See https://maintenease.com/llms-full.txt for the combined corpus.

## Solutions

- [Work Order Software](https://maintenease.com/solutions/work-order-software.md): Capture, assign, and close work orders without the spreadsheet sprawl.
- [Preventive Maintenance Software](https://maintenease.com/solutions/preventive-maintenance-software.md): Schedule by date, runtime, or meter — and watch reactive work shrink.
- [Facility Maintenance Software](https://maintenease.com/solutions/facility-maintenance-software.md): One system for assets, work orders, PMs, and tenant requests across every building.
- [Fleet Maintenance Software](https://maintenease.com/solutions/fleet-maintenance-software.md): Meter-based PMs, DVIRs, and compliance reports — without the spreadsheet.
- [Maintenance Request Portal](https://maintenease.com/solutions/maintenance-request-portal.md): Standard requests and an urgent lane — submissions land straight in your inbox.
- [Asset Tracking Software](https://maintenease.com/solutions/asset-tracking-software.md): QR codes, locations, custody, and full service history — for every asset you own.
- [Asset Management Software](https://maintenease.com/solutions/asset-management-software.md): Register, schedule, maintain, and report on every asset — in one place.

## Comparisons

- [MaintenEase vs UpKeep](https://maintenease.com/compare/maintenease-vs-upkeep.md): The same core CMMS — without paying by the technician.
- [MaintenEase vs Fiix](https://maintenease.com/compare/maintenease-vs-fiix.md): Account plans with included seats compared with per-user pricing.
- [MaintenEase vs MaintainX](https://maintenease.com/compare/maintenease-vs-maintainx.md): Account plans with included seats and published capacity limits.
- [MaintenEase vs Limble](https://maintenease.com/compare/maintenease-vs-limble.md): Account and per-user pricing for preventive maintenance teams.
- [MaintenEase vs eMaint](https://maintenease.com/compare/maintenease-vs-emaint.md): A modern, mobile-first alternative to legacy enterprise CMMS.

## Learn (glossary)

- [CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System)](https://maintenease.com/learn/cmms.md): Software that centralizes work orders, assets, and preventive maintenance schedules so teams stop relying on spreadsheets and paper.
- [Agentic CMMS: AI Agents for Maintenance Workflows](https://maintenease.com/learn/agentic-cmms.md): A CMMS that lets authorized AI agents retrieve maintenance data and complete workflow steps, such as reviewing requests or creating work orders, while preserving permissions and human oversight.
- [Preventive Maintenance](https://maintenease.com/learn/preventive-maintenance.md): Scheduled service performed before equipment fails — by calendar date, runtime hours, or meter reading — to extend asset life and avoid downtime.
- [Work Order](https://maintenease.com/learn/work-order.md): A formal request that describes a maintenance task — what needs doing, on which asset, by whom, when — and tracks it from creation to completion.
- [Facility Maintenance](https://maintenease.com/learn/facility-maintenance.md): All the work required to keep a building and its systems safe, comfortable, and operational — HVAC, plumbing, electrical, lighting, life safety, and the building envelope.
- [Fleet Maintenance](https://maintenease.com/learn/fleet-maintenance.md): Keeping a group of vehicles — trucks, vans, cars, heavy equipment — safe, compliant, and on the road through scheduled service and quick reactive repairs.
- [MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Operations)](https://maintenease.com/learn/mro.md): The supplies, parts, and consumables a maintenance team uses to keep operations running — separate from raw materials that become finished products.
- [Building Maintenance](https://maintenease.com/learn/building-maintenance.md): The day-to-day and scheduled work needed to keep a building's structure, systems, and finishes in safe and serviceable condition.
- [Property Maintenance](https://maintenease.com/learn/property-maintenance.md): Ongoing upkeep of residential or commercial rental property — units, common areas, grounds, and life-safety systems — to protect the asset and keep tenants happy.
- [Reactive Maintenance](https://maintenease.com/learn/reactive-maintenance.md): Fixing equipment after it has already broken down — the unplanned, run-to-failure work that a maintenance program tries to shrink.
- [Predictive Maintenance](https://maintenease.com/learn/predictive-maintenance.md): Using live condition data — vibration, temperature, current — to predict failures and service equipment just before it would break, not on a fixed calendar.
- [Corrective Maintenance](https://maintenease.com/learn/corrective-maintenance.md): Planned repair work that fixes a known defect found during an inspection or PM — before it becomes a breakdown.
- [Condition-Based Maintenance](https://maintenease.com/learn/condition-based-maintenance.md): Servicing equipment when a monitored condition (temperature, vibration, pressure) crosses a defined threshold — not on a fixed schedule.
- [MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)](https://maintenease.com/learn/mtbf.md): The average operating time between one failure and the next for a repairable asset — a core reliability metric maintenance teams track to spot bad actors.
- [MTTR (Mean Time To Repair)](https://maintenease.com/learn/mttr.md): The average time it takes to restore a failed asset to working order — a key maintainability metric that captures how fast your team responds.
- [CMMS Benchmarks (2026)](https://maintenease.com/learn/cmms-benchmarks-2026.md): Citable industry benchmarks for maintenance teams — planned-vs-reactive ratios, MTTR, PM compliance, and cost per work order — with sources and methodology.
- [CMMS ROI & Cost Savings](https://maintenease.com/learn/cmms-roi.md): How to calculate the return on a CMMS investment — downtime avoided, PM compliance gains, labor efficiency, and parts inventory savings — with worked examples.
- [Root Cause Analysis (RCA)](https://maintenease.com/learn/root-cause-analysis.md): A structured method for finding why a failure happened — not just what broke — so the same problem can be eliminated instead of repeatedly repaired.
- [Deferred Maintenance](https://maintenease.com/learn/deferred-maintenance.md): Maintenance work that is known, needed, and postponed — usually for budget or staffing reasons — and that quietly accumulates into a backlog with a price tag.
- [AI Maintenance Assistant](https://maintenease.com/learn/ai-maintenance-assistant.md): An AI interface that helps maintenance teams find records, summarize work, prepare actions, and spend less time navigating CMMS screens.
- [CMMS for ChatGPT](https://maintenease.com/learn/cmms-for-chatgpt.md): A secure connection that lets ChatGPT use approved CMMS tools to retrieve maintenance records or complete defined workflow steps for an authenticated user.
- [Maintenance MCP Server](https://maintenease.com/learn/maintenance-mcp-server.md): A Model Context Protocol service that exposes controlled maintenance data and actions to compatible AI clients without granting direct database access.
- [AI Work Order Automation](https://maintenease.com/learn/ai-work-order-automation.md): Using AI to turn maintenance requests and operational context into structured work orders while keeping priorities, approvals, and execution under human control.
- [Equipment Risk Scoring](https://maintenease.com/learn/equipment-risk-scoring.md): A repeatable way to rank assets by likelihood and consequence of failure so maintenance teams can direct limited labor toward the most important work.
- [Predictive Maintenance Without Sensors](https://maintenease.com/learn/predictive-maintenance-without-sensors.md): A practical approach that uses work history, manual readings, inspections, and failure patterns to prioritize equipment risk before investing in permanent sensors.
- [Maintenance Request QR Codes](https://maintenease.com/learn/maintenance-request-qr-codes.md): QR codes that open a location- or asset-specific request form so tenants, operators, staff, or guests can report problems without installing an app.
- [AI-Native CMMS](https://maintenease.com/learn/ai-native-cmms.md): Maintenance software designed around AI-assisted retrieval, reasoning, and controlled actions rather than adding a generic chatbot to a legacy workflow.
- [Agentic Maintenance Workflows](https://maintenease.com/learn/agentic-maintenance-workflows.md): Controlled maintenance processes in which an AI agent retrieves CMMS context and completes approved software steps while people retain operational authority.

## Free maintenance templates

- [Maintenance Log Template](https://maintenease.com/templates/maintenance-log-template.md): Record every repair, inspection, and preventive task in one consistent maintenance log. The template gives each entry an asset, owner, cost, status, and next-service date so the spreadsheet stays useful as the history grows.
- [Preventive Maintenance Checklist](https://maintenease.com/templates/preventive-maintenance-checklist.md): Turn recurring maintenance into a schedule your team can actually follow. This preventive maintenance checklist defines the asset, task, frequency, acceptance criteria, responsible role, and next due date in one portable sheet.
- [Work Order Template](https://maintenease.com/templates/work-order-template.md): Capture a maintenance request, turn it into assigned work, and preserve the close-out details. This work order template covers the full record from requester and priority through labor, parts, completion date, and technician notes.
